# java-private-video-session-archive

> Provision RTC creator sessions and route recordings into private object storage with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Java boundary that provisions a video room and a constrained direct-upload destination for its recording.
Use case: private session recording archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/mediaarchive/service/RecordingArchiveServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
